checks.detail: Full-unassessed. Independent ordinary input demonstrated Q01 acceptance, sword acquisition/practice, first combat and remnant reward, Ronen's bow lesson, and save/restart continuity. This does not establish opening CG, old-lamp acquisition/training, first upgrade, bridge/pillar progression, or the required dialogue and supply-sidequest breadth. Future milestones remain pending. coverage.baseline.adjacent_continuity.1fa5438163b4=insufficient_evidence; only the MAP01-to-MAP02 handoff boundary was considered, and chapter-exit prerequisites prevented reaching it.

Full-unassessed. Fresh unarmed startup, ordinary sword and bow acquisition/use, repeat handoff/refill, and separate sword-only/bow save histories were independently observed. Both selected bow task conditions pass. Old-lamp acquisition/use and armor protection remain unestablished; required portraits and Isha clothing presentation remain defective. Local task acceptance cannot close the compound R04 criterion.

Full-unassessed. Actual sword target contact and simulated defense succeeded after unsuccessful attempts; Ronen demonstrated the bow. Charged projectile contact, obstruction, miss, cancellation, repeated release, empty ammunition and free refill were correlated with authoritative state. Menu/equipment/load cleanup was observed. Lamp revelation, elemental lessons, affected death/terminal recovery and complete chapter training continuity remain unverified. The input patrol found no proven defect in the exercised bindings; the UI patrol reproduced existing presentation defects.

developer_outcome.summary: Retained actor provenance and live component binding were checked. Ordinary bow grant, correlated projectile contact/ammunition, obstruction, cancellation, saved continuity and heard audio remain unverified. R04 and all unresolved presentation acceptance remain open.

risk_note.summary: The most likely insufficient-evidence outcome is a visible training success without independently correlated first-contact/ammunition history, or sound quality inferred from silent frames. Shared save changes can also erase earlier sword history.
risk_note.validation: Developer provides bounded authoritative observations and ordinary-input smoke; Host/Tester independently capture grant, cancel, blocked/contact release and save/restart, plus heard or captured audio. Keep unsupported fixtures and unobserved sound explicitly blocked.
risk_note.why_now: The connected-slice issue has stalled across repeated loops, and the inspected bow component lacks the product state needed to demonstrate the next route step.

task_requirements.requirement: After the existing sword lesson, ordinary movement and conversation with Ronen grant the bow once and enable a repeatable charged-shot lesson that completes only on the released arrow's first legitimate target contact, with coordinated bow animation and visible authoritative ammunition.

A safe save and restart restore bow ownership, selected equipment, ammunition and confirmed training without another handoff or queued shot; an earlier sword-only save remains loadable with the bow unowned.
